messages.subject: Decimal sign in data sets
parts:
Deducer is excellent, however I have an annoying problem that prevents
me from directly importing my data files containing numbers using
comma as decimal point (as is common in several European countries). I
can see Deducer uses read.table() to import its data, so the dec =
option should be available to implement.
For us unlucky non-Americans I would like to see a choice of "decimal
sign", similar to that of "record separator" and "quote" in the import
dialog.
